## KaliScriber 0.7.0

Install the `arm64-v8a` APK on most phones (`universal` if unsure). It updates over earlier builds and keeps your meetings and settings. On first start, meetings are converted to the new storage format and indexed for search in the background.

### Keep your meetings safe
- **Backup & restore** (Settings). Puts your meetings with their transcripts and summaries, plus your notes, saved voices, settings, Ask all meetings conversation and AI usage, into one file locked with a password. Recordings are included if you choose. Save it to Google Drive, a computer or anywhere else. API keys and passwords are never included. Restoring adds what the phone doesn't have yet and never overwrites anything. A changed, incomplete or wrong-password backup is refused.
- **Storage** (Settings). Shows how much space recordings, meetings, on-device models and the search index use. **Keep recordings** (30 days, 90 days, 6 months or 1 year) deletes older recordings and keeps their transcripts, summaries and notes. A meeting that was never transcribed keeps its recording. You can also delete one meeting's recording from its menu.

### Better notes
- **Summary formats** for 1:1s, stand-ups, sales calls, interviews and lectures. Each adds sections that matter for that kind of meeting, for example done, next and blockers for each person at a stand-up. The format is guessed from the meeting or calendar title, and you can change it on the summary.
- **Glossary words heard correctly.** With an on-device Parakeet model, the recogniser listens out for your glossary's names and terms while you record, so they come out right in the transcript itself. This doesn't slow transcription down.
- **Cleaner audio and microphone choice** (Settings → Meeting processing). Noise suppression and automatic volume are on by default. You can record from a wired, USB or Bluetooth headset instead of the phone.

### Asking
- **Smart search** (Settings, optional 30 MB download). Ask all meetings also finds passages by meaning, so a question about cost finds talk about prices. It runs on the phone.
- **Stop** an answer while it's being written; what arrived so far is kept.
- **Hands-free answers are spoken sentence by sentence** as the AI writes them, instead of after the whole answer.

### Also new
- **AI usage & cost** (Settings). Shows the tokens each model used this month and, once you enter prices, the cost. A meeting's Processing details lists what its AI requests used.
- **Shared videos keep only their sound**, so a screen recording or video call takes far less space.
- **Hundreds of meetings stay fast.** Transcripts stay on disk until a meeting is opened, and search and Ask all meetings use an on-device index.
